Pastel sky blue, cream, mint, peach, coral-pink and dark-plum palette; crisp hard pixels; simple readable shapes; charming toy-room style; no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no photorealism, no smooth antialiasing. Use the supplied full-canvas flat material guide exactly. A seamless front-facing texture swatch for a blank cream toy die surface, warm ivory matte painted wood with very sparse cream and peach 1 to 2 pixel flecks, four colors maximum, tile seamlessly on all edges. It must fill the entire square as a flat texture: no circle, die object, pips, dots, numerals, letters, symbols, silhouette, perspective, border, shadow, blue backdrop or gradients.
